purpose: Teach: こみ/削る/利く/扱える/照らさ/考え直し/挙がっ/緩め

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、人こみの中、商談に出向いていた。
lines.en: When I was younger, I used to go out into crowds to make deals.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Let the memory settle in the air. Quiet authority — not lecturing, remembering. Gentle exhale at the end, like watching something distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。無駄を削る経営、長く続けています。
lines.en: Yes. I've been running a lean operation for a long time.
lines.style: Respectful nod beneath the words. Calm, direct delivery. Slight emphasis on the duration — pride without boasting. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 勘が利く部下、大事にしろ。
lines.en: Hold onto the staff who have good instincts. They're rare.
lines.style: Soft weight on the opening. Short, clear sentences — each one matters. Spoken like hard-won advice, not a directive. Slight pause after 'rare.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国際案件を扱える社員、揃ってきました。
lines.en: We're building a team that can handle international projects now.
lines.style: Slight lift in tone — this is progress worth noting. Warm but professional. Speak it like an accomplishment, not a status report. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 光に照らされた成功、皆で共有しろ。
lines.en: When success comes, make sure everyone shares in the light of it.
lines.style: Intentional cadence. Let 'light' breathe slightly — it's metaphorical, generous. Not commanding, inviting. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。引き継ぎ、再度、考え直しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm rethinking how we handle the handover of responsibilities.
lines.style: Thoughtful, not rushed. Slight self-correction feel — like this is active work, not a done thing. Open at the end, like there's more thinking to do.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 課題、挙がってきた時、即決しろ。
lines.en: When problems come up, decide quickly. Don't hesitate.
lines.style: Sharper than before. Clear directive, not gentle. Brief, powerful. Slight punch on 'quickly' — this is the practical wisdom, the edge of the advice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。スケジュール、緩めに、柔軟に。
lines.en: Yes. Give the schedule room to breathe. Build in flexibility.
lines.style: Warm close. Balanced rhythm — neither rushed nor plodding. The final reassurance to a successor. Slight softening at the end, like settling something important.
